integration: The bounded cellar review of the Brennan’s house cards, 11 October 2026: the six research/cellar-review-2026-10-11-house files and their notes, as the refuters left them, applied to brennans/overrides.json and built into the 23:30 edition, then repaired by the verifier and rebuilt as the 01:00 edition of 12 October.
resumed: A run of this integration was cut by a container restart at about 23:35 UTC on 11 October, after appending 261 entries (244 replace or set entries and 17 asks), stamping 23:30 and mirroring a pack. This run read git diff of overrides.json and engine.mjs, matched every appended entry against the six review files (none missing, none duplicated, none appended twice), kept the stamp, held back one entry (below), tidied the reasons, and ran the whole chain and every check again from the start.

entries[14] (Dominus 2014): the review named the field guest, the pack’s name; the override names it sayIt, the model’s name for the same line (build-brennans.mjs newWine maps guest to sayIt), and the from matched there.

sourcesAndReasons: Every appended entry’s source opens research:cellar-review-2026-10-11-house-<batch>.md#<section>; where a review entry named only the producer research, the review note’s section was put first and the producer source kept after it. notApplied.why: True and sourced, and not on the lead’s 10(d) list. Filling the empty list adds one wineGrapes question to the house (1,320 to 1,321 questions dealt), which moves the fixed seed of src/lib/house-drill-round.test.ts, “deals a section round of section items with options from the whole house” (seed 7), so its Entrées round deals no option that is a dish from another section and the test fails; the round itself stays valid. The test is not a file this integration may edit, so the set waits for an edition that reseeds or widens that test. The entry as the earlier run filed it is kept in this file under heldBackEntry.

asksFiled.question: What soils does Ridgeview’s Ditchling vineyard, where the Bloomsbury grows, stand on: chalk, as some pages say, or clay, limestone, flint and loam, as a retailer’s sheet for the Bloomsbury says?

Which Napa vineyards grow the Chateau Montelena Chardonnay 2023? The importer’s sheets name the south-central Napa Valley near Mount Veeder, another reference names the Oak Knoll District, and neither names Calistoga, where the winery stands.
Which Meursault parcels make the Coche-Dury Bourgogne Blanc 2022? Only one merchant places them, as parcels across the domaine in Meursault; nothing from the estate says so.
Is the Mas de Valériole Vé 2025 magnum labeled IGP Méditerranée, as our list prints it, or IGP Pays des Bouches-du-Rhône, Terre de Camargue, the label the estate uses for some of its other wines?
items: Mas de Valériole ‘Vé’ Rosé Méditerranée 2025 (1.5 L magnum)

asksFiled.question: Does the Pétrus 1980 (bin 21131) carry a little Cabernet Franc, as the estate grew some in those years, or is it all Merlot as our card lists it?
Does the Fèlsina Rancia 2019 (bin 16433) label read Chianti Classico Riserva, as the list prints, or Chianti Classico Gran Selezione?
items: Fattoria di Fèlsina ‘Rancia’ Chianti Classico Riserva 2019

asksFiled.question: The Joseph Phelps Insignia 2013 card calls Insignia California’s first proprietary Bordeaux-style blend, and the Insignia 2011 half-bottle card, the wine list and one October card say one of the first: which does the sommelier want the floor to say?
Who planted Martha’s Vineyard in Oakville: Tom and Martha May, or an earlier owner before them? Our cards now say only that it was the Mays’ vineyard.

If a guest asks who runs the house today, what does the sommelier want said, with a dated source, for Bartolo Mascarello, Gaja, Kracher, Niepoort, Harlan Estate, Dominus, Caymus, Chappellet, Quintarelli, Piedrasassi and Broadbent? The cards now give only who founded or made each name.
items: Caymus ‘Special Selection’ Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
Giuseppe Quintarelli Recioto della Valpolicella Classico 1997
Piedrasassi ‘Bien Nacido Vineyard’ Santa Maria Valley Syrah 2021

asksFiled.question: Did Castello Banfi revive Moscadello di Montalcino, or join growers already making it? Our cards said revived; no source does, and they now say only that Banfi makes Florus.

The château calls the Moulin d’Issan Merlot-led and the importer’s sheet for the 2021 gives 90 percent Merlot, yet the current menu and Binwise head it under Cabernet Sauvignon blends: should the menus head it as a Merlot blend?

What vine age may a server quote for the Fichet Château London, and what age does Domaine Fichet give for the parcel? No source gives a hundred years, the cards now say only old vines, and one listing of the 2018 gives 86 years for the oldest vine.
